notes: Traced from the Ground Floor (bottom left of the sheet) of the UCLA Library sheet.

The sheet is drawn south up (its compass has E on the left and W on the right); UCLA's main entrance is on the north face and the plan's Main Entrance is at the bottom, so the plan is turned 180 degrees. The fit uses the outer wall corners of the two wings and of the wider north block against the building outline.

Elevators are the gray boxes with the up/down glyph and stairs the hatched boxes (both from the sheet's legend); they are added as hand-placed boxes at the sheet's positions. Restroom icons (legend: Restrooms) set the kind of the room holding them.

The sheet leaves openings in the outer wall of the west wing (plan right) on floors 0, 2 and 3 and in the east wall on floors 0 and 1; cuts close them so the rooms along those walls (228, 238, 330) don't leak outside.
The library plan is a diagram: rooms are drawn as blocks with simplified walls; open areas (rotunda, stacks, reading room) are separated along the drawn wall lines and by their labels.
The two restroom icons next to room 70 point with arrows at the small rooms east of them; those rooms get the restroom kind.
